messages:
alex: Heads up: our CI started failing on the sample app first call. Getting a 402 Payment Required from /v1/chat/completions even though the same key works locally. Anyone seen weird billing gating like this?

katie: can you paste the exact response body (redact tokens)? 402 usually means the workspace the credential belongs to doesn't have billing.

alex: pasted below (redacted):

HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "billing.required",
    "message": "Billing must be configured for workspace to use API"
  }
}

alex: local dev uses my user-scoped API key from the org workspace; CI uses a service account key we created when onboarding the repo.

ben: sounds like the SA is probably in the onboarding workspace that doesn't have a payment method. Quick check: run `rwctl sa describe --id <sa-id>` or look in Console > Settings > Service accounts to see workspace_id.

katie: small nuance: our JS SDK will retry on transient 5xx and 429, but we explicitly don't retry 4xx like 402. So the sample app will surface the billing error immediately — not a retry flake.

alex: confirmed the SA's workspace_id is a temp workspace (id: w_3f2). That workspace never got billing attached. Oops.

ben: options: 1) create an org-level SA for CI, 2) attach a payment method to the temp workspace, or 3) update CI to use a user-scoped key from the org (not ideal).

alex: we'll create an org-level SA and rotate creds in CI. Quick question: should the error message include the workspace id so it's easier to debug? Right now it's pretty generic.

katie: agreed. We shouldn't leak PII but returning workspace_id (or a truncated id) in the error would help debug. Filing a ticket to add a hint like: "workspace: <id> requires billing" and a docs blurb.

ben: filing DEVEX-789: "Include workspace id/hint on billing errors for service credentials" and adding a checklist item to the sample-app quickstart to remind teams to use org-level SAs or verify workspace billing.

devex-bot: created DEVEX-789 and linked to docs PR draft.

infra-bot: note: if you want a quick workaround, create an SA in the org workspace and grant it minimal roles, then add its key to CI. Remember to rotate keys after use.

alex: fixed (new SA in org added, CI rotated)  pipeline green. I'll open a tiny PR to the quickstart README to add the SA/billing troubleshooting section. Thanks!

katie: can someone add a short entry in the SDK exceptions guide about 402 vs auth errors? New hires keep confusing 401 vs billing 402.

ben: done in the docs backlog, assigning to docs eng.

alex: leaving a note in repo README and closing thread. :pride_flag:
